claims-volume.description: Multiple criteria: (1) Total other service (OT) header volume as a percentage of the national median, (2) total OT line volume as a percentage of the national median, and (3) average number of OT line records per header as a percentage of the national median in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
claims-volume.label: Claims Volume – OT
claims-volume.metric_label: OT File Header Records per 1,000 Enrolled Months as % of National Median

cmc-encounters.description: Multiple criteria: (1) Other service (OT) comprehensive managed care (CMC) encounter header record volume as a percentage of the national median, (2) volume of OT CMC encounter line records as a percentage of the national median, (3) the average number of OT CMC line records per header as a percentage of the national median, and (4) the number of CMC plans with no OT encounter header records in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
cmc-encounters.label: CMC Plan Encounters – OT
cmc-encounters.metric_label: OT File Encounter Header Records per 1,000 Enrolled Months as % of National Median

link-bene.description: Percentage of service use records that do not link to an eligibility record in the same month of service in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
link-bene.label: Linking Claims to Beneficiaries
link-bene.metric_label: % Service Use Records That Do Not Link to Eligibility Record in Month of Service

link-providers.description: Percentage of unique provider IDs on medical claims in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) that link to a provider ID on the TAF Annual Provider (APR) file
link-providers.label: Linking Claims to Providers
link-providers.metric_label: % Unique Provider IDs on Medical Claims That Link to a Provider ID on the APR File

missing-pmt-enc.description: Percentage of managed care (MC) encounters with a zero, missing, or negative payment amount in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
missing-pmt-enc.label: Missing Payment Data – Encounters
missing-pmt-enc.metric_label: % MC Encounters with Zero, Missing, or Neg Payment Amt

missing-pmt-ffs.description: Percentage of fee-for-service (FFS) claims with a zero, missing, or negative payment amount in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
missing-pmt-ffs.label: Missing Payment Data – FFS Claims
missing-pmt-ffs.metric_label: % FFS Claims with Zero, Missing, or Neg Payment Amt

pmt-consistency.description: Multiple criteria: (1) Percentage of fee-for-service (FFS) other service (OT) claims with a header payment equal to the sum of its associated claim line payments and (2) percentage of OT claims with an unknown payment level in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
pmt-consistency.label: Payment Data Consistency – OT
pmt-consistency.metric_label: % FFS Header Records with Pmt Equal to Sum of Line Pmts in OT File

proc-cd-inst.description: Percentage of all other service (OT) institutional claim line records with missing or invalid values in the procedure code field in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
proc-cd-inst.label: Procedure Codes – OT Institutional
proc-cd-inst.metric_label: % Institutional Claim Lines with Missing or Invalid Procedure Code in OT File

proc-cd-prof.description: Percentage of all other service (OT) professional claim line records with missing or invalid values in the procedure code field in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF)
proc-cd-prof.label: Procedure Codes – OT Professional
proc-cd-prof.metric_label: % Professional Claim Lines with Missing or Invalid Procedure Code in OT File

service-users.description: Percentage of non-dually eligible beneficiaries with at least one other service (OT) claim record in the T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF), as a proportion of the national median
service-users.label: Service Users – OT
service-users.metric_label: % Non-Dually Eligible Beneficiaries with Any Service Use in OT File as % of National Median
